presets.name: Deep Current
presets.description: Pure low-frequency weight with a soft harmonic edge.
presets.howToPlay: Play single notes below C3; hold them.
presets.designerNotes: The cleanest of the family: a triangle body, the saw only a whisper above it.
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Furnace Teeth
presets.description: A distorted sync bass with a ferocious harmonic bite.
presets.howToPlay: Try pitch bends and fast mono lines; the wheel opens the throat.
presets.designerNotes: Hard sync swept by its own envelope, so every note rips open and closes; a clean SUB holds the floor.
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Cathedral Below
presets.category: Cinematic bass drones and colossal hybrid foundations
presets.description: A low organ of octaves and fifths, breathing slowly in a vast stone room.
presets.howToPlay: Hold low chords and pedal notes; let the room answer.
presets.designerNotes: Organ registration (square, fifth, sub-octave) with a slow tidal filter - no detune, no grit.
presets.file: presets/Cinematic Afterimages Vol. 2/Monumental Low End/Cathedral Below.andoranalog
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Long Afterlight
presets.description: A warm, singing lead suspended in an enormous space.
presets.howToPlay: Play slowly and use the mod wheel; strike harder to open it.
presets.designerNotes: Brass-like bloom from velocity, delayed vibrato on the wheel, a nine-second hall kept dark.
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Amber Meridian
presets.description: A warm reed with a brassy bite when you dig in.
presets.howToPlay: Vary your velocity; aftertouch brightens a held note.
presets.designerNotes: Narrow pulse over a triangle: soft playing is a reed, hard playing a horn; vibrato arrives late on its own.
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Slow Northern Light
presets.description: Wide string-machine light, drifting open over long chords.
presets.howToPlay: Hold wide chords for several bars.
presets.designerNotes: DCO saw and swept pulse through the Juno filter and its chorus; the filter slowly breathes upward.
presets.file: presets/Cinematic Afterimages Vol. 2/Slow Light/Slow Northern Light.andoranalog
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Copper Choir
presets.description: A massive synthetic brass section, warm and wide.
presets.howToPlay: Play full chords; accent with velocity.
presets.designerNotes: Three saw voices (one an octave down on card C) blooming through the ladder on every chord.
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Lost Telemetry
presets.description: A retro sixteenth-note pulse, narrow and filtered, with stereo echoes.
presets.howToPlay: Hold a chord; change the arpeggiator's rate and octaves.
presets.designerNotes: A narrow pulse through a resonant ladder, plucked short, echoed across the stereo field by a BBD.
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Signal Grave
presets.description: A deep, ominous drone with faint radio static and slow, uneasy pitch.
presets.howToPlay: Hold one low note or a fifth; let it evolve.
presets.designerNotes: Low saw and detuned triangle wander in pitch under a breath of filtered noise, in a dark endless space.
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom

presets.name: Glass Raindrops
presets.category: Keys, bells, plucks and cinematic effects
presets.description: Delicate metallic drops falling into a soft, cascading space.
presets.howToPlay: Play sparse high notes and broken chords.
presets.designerNotes: Ring modulation against a fifth gives the metal; a fast pluck and a long plate let each drop fall.
presets.fxRoute: v1 custom fx drive.1 on fx movement.1 on par send 2 lane 1 { fx echo.1 on } lane 1 { fx space.1 on } | v1 custom
